# Roxane Foare

> Freelance video editor based in Paris & Angers, France. More than 10 years
> of experience editing film, documentary, commercial, corporate, live
> broadcast and event video.

Roxane Foare is a video editor (monteuse vidéo) working across Adobe Premiere
Pro, DaVinci Resolve and Avid Media Composer. She has cut projects for brands
and productions including Estée Lauder, Hennessy, BNP Paribas, Givenchy,
Lacoste, Société Générale, Carrefour, JP Morgan, Sanofi and others, spanning
commercials, feature films, documentaries, corporate films, live sports
broadcast (PSG, Volleyball World Cup) and events.

Site language: English is the default (`/`), French is available at `/fr`
(same content, translated interface).

## Pages

- [Portfolio (EN)](https://roxane-foare.com/): work grid, about, contact -
  commercial, feature film, documentary, corporate, event, teaser and live
  broadcast projects, filterable by category.
- [Portfolio (FR)](https://roxane-foare.com/fr): identical content in French.

## Contact

Contact form and email link on the site (`/#contact`). See also the IMDb
profile linked from the site's structured data.

## Notes for automated agents

- The work grid is server-rendered static HTML (no client-side data fetch
  required to read project titles, credits and years).
- Video playback embeds are Vimeo (`player.vimeo.com`); thumbnails are
  self-hosted WebP images.
- `/admin` is a content editor (Sveltia CMS) behind GitHub OAuth - not a
  public page, do not index or crawl.
